Because the state is one-narrative, crowded, and not directional, the base view leans low and few theses are offered.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (rank 2, score 1.015, but eligible=false) can regain trend eligibility and push its durability bar from 0.16 up through 0.5 while Oil & Gas breadth decays; it only becomes a confirmed handoff candidate if it clears the absolute-trend gate AND its breadth rises above 0.4 — until then it is not a call.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas is the dominant narrative: highest momentum score, strong durability bar (0.71), exceptional breadth (0.929), and a trend-eligible state that passes the absolute-trend gate. The trend gate is the only validated risk-control leg, and this theme sits inside it. Crowding (z 1.19, crowded=true) is a size-down caution, not a reason to avoid or fade.
evidence: durability_bar=0.71 — upper range, resilient relative to peers
breadth=0.929 — leadership is broad, not a thin one-name spike
eligible=true — passes the validated absolute-trend gate
crowding_z=1.19, crowded=true — reflexivity risk, cap rather than fade
theses.dissent: As a momentum leader with high crowding and one-narrative concentration, Oil & Gas is most exposed to an attention peak and a sharp mean-reversion flush; the detector's own rank-IC is ~0, so leadership alone carries no forward return edge, and the 75% unscheduled macro surprise share means any headline can overturn the energy trade quickly.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is trend-eligible (eligible=true) with a solid durability bar (0.63) and a trend hurst tag, meaning it survives the validated absolute-trend gate that is the one proven drawdown-control leg. It is not crowded (z 0.15) and has moderate breadth (0.429), so it offers a secondary trend-following hold without the one-narrative concentration risk of the leader.
evidence: crowding_z=0.15 — not crowded, lower reflexivity risk
breath=0.429 — leadership is narrow but non-zero
theses.dissent: Big Banks is momentum-neutral (score 0.635, only rank 5) and its breadth is below half, so the trend could rotate away fast; with no forward edge in rank, this is a risk-control hold rather than an alpha call, and financials can lag hard when energy dominates the index.
